name: Shamieh Law
about: Shamieh Law works from Thomas Avenue in Dallas, names ten people and describes a practice across Texas, Louisiana and Arkansas. Its Google listings average a flat five stars across 600 reviews, which no other firm of that size in this market does.
A free consultation and a 24 hour line, published. No fee model stated in terms we could record, and no case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: SHAMIEH LAW, PLLC is registered with the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, under number 0802460460, since 2016-05-19, with an active status and the right to transact business, and 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 10 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 600 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-12-03, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: 3 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (3/25).

subs.label: Experience
subs.evidence: Texas publishes no attorney register we can query, so years since admission cannot be established here for any firm and this is not scored.

subs.label: Roster verifiability
subs.evidence: Texas publishes no attorney register we can query, so the roster is not verified here and this is not scored.

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: member of State Bar of Texas, Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Dallas Bar Association and 2 more · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Results published
subs.evidence: 14 results published on the firm's own site, counted from stated amounts

subs.label: Specificity
subs.evidence: 6 case types named; no court or county named, so no result can be looked up

subs.label: Results disclosure
subs.evidence: No prior-results disclaimer on the results page, which the New York advertising rules effectively require

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 942 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.97 over 942 reviews → Bayesian 4.96 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 300 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 11 of 15 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-08-18) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 0 of 15 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no bar numbers on bios · no fee statement · privacy policy · no disclaimer · fresh content

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 45 → 87th pct of 19-firm cohort (median 37) 3/3 · 978 referring domains, 63th pct 1/2 · 681 organic keywords / 2,804 visits·mo, 79th pct 2/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 3 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · fee model not published · the fee percentage itself is not published
